title: デビュー戦の後に・最大の魅力

text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle thoroughly enjoys her race, giving everyone a taste of her aptitude for sprints and miles along the way.
Nevertheless, becoming Umamusume of the Year through sprint and mile races alone will mean climbing a very steep path.
But after witnessing Taiki Shuttle's full running potential, I believe she can achieve miracles.
And so, we choose to run in the mile race of the winter season, the Shinzan Kinen!
